The complete application is built, tested, and ready for your final review.

## ✅ Bookmark Manager — complete and verified

All **67 tasks** across all 12 user stories are implemented and marked done. The app is registered with the runtime (`.harness/app.json`, port 4000) — open **http://maker:4000**. The broker starts it automatically, serving a small set of sample bookmarks so you can see every feature immediately (4 active, 1 archived, with tags and notes).

### Verification (all actually run, all green)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| **Unit tests** (`npm test`) | **18/18 pass** — search parser (every contract example), Markdown sanitization, metadata parsing, import/export round-trip |
| **Browser e2e** (Playwright 1.61.0, shared Chromium) | **30/30 pass** — one per user story + the two you added + cross-cutting |
| **Performance** (`tests/perf/seed.js`) | Search over **1,000 bookmarks in ~1ms**; bulk over 60 in ~2ms (SC-005/SC-006) |
| **Cross-cutting** | Data survives server restart (SC-004); archive→restore preserves tags/notes/copies (SC-007) |

### What's delivered, by story
- **US1** Save with auto title/description/icon/preview; duplicate → opens existing; graceful fallback when a page is unreachable
- **US2** Readable list (title, description, tags, icon); open in new tab; empty state
- **US3** Tags with existing-tag suggestions; filter by tag
- **US4** Markdown notes (bold/italics/lists/links, sanitized); edit all fields; delete with confirmation — *plus your added browser check*
- **US5** Case-insensitive search across title/description/note/address; `#tag` (narrows with text); `"phrases"`; `AND/OR/NOT`/parentheses; quoted `"AND"` literal — *plus your added note-through-search check*
- **US6** Read-later status + unread view · **US7** Reversible archiving, hidden from lists/search
- **US8** Bulk add/remove tag, read/unread, archive, delete — on a selection or everything matching the view
- **US9** Saved searches (text + included/excluded tags) · **US10** Sorting + persisted display prefs (sort, page size, text size)
- **US11** Saved copies: self-contained HTML for pages, the PDF itself for PDFs, optional Internet Archive with honest failure
- **US12** Import/export in Netscape bookmark HTML, preserving title/tags/original date, skipping duplicates — *plus your added browser check*

### Two honest implementation notes (recorded in the artifacts)
- **Storage driver**: `node:sqlite` instead of `better-sqlite3` (Node 24 teardown crash) — same file-based SQLite architecture.
- **Snapshots**: self-contained HTML is produced by fetch + resource-inlining rather than headless Chromium — same offline-openable result, lighter and deterministic. Both are documented in `research.md`.

Every network-dependent feature degrades gracefully, and in this review environment (where outbound internet to arbitrary sites / the Internet Archive may be restricted) the app falls back honestly rather than faking success — the e2e suite proves the behavior with local fixtures.

The spec, plan, tasks, and design docs in `specs/001-bookmark-manager/` are all current. Please take a look at http://maker:4000 — happy to adjust anything through the spec if you'd like changes.
